title: Cool Tools & Weapons - Data Pack
description: This Data Pack adds: 5 new bosses,30+ new items,1 new dimension,1 new soul system to allow changes to spawners in a survival friendly way,3 new structures to that dimension,5 new biomes;
body:
## This pack adds:
- 1 New dimention to the game,
- 5 new biomes to said dimension,
- 3 new dungeons inserted in the dimension,
- 1 new portal structure (spawn at 0 0 0, portal to new dimention - drop a emerald block in the midle to start entering the dimension),
- 30+ new items,
- 5 new summona-ble bosses,
- 1 Secret Boss,
- 1 World Boss,
- And a new soul sistem to change mobs inside spawners.

Please use the ResPack with the Data Pack [CTW-ResPack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ctw-respack)

Cool Tools and Weapons is the Predecessor of [Cool Boosses and Crafts](https://modrinth.com/datapack/cbc1_datapack),
